name: C7700 Clonyx
lines: ที่สุดของความสบาย ที่ออกแบบมาให้ สวมใส่ง่าย และสบายในทุกก้าว

สัมผัส Comfort อีกระดับ ด้วยรูปทรงรองเท้าที่ออกแบบใหม่ เพิ่มพื้นที่บริเวณหน้าเท้าและหลังเท้า ลดการบีบรัด ให้เท้าเคลื่อนไหวได้อย่างเป็นธรรมชาติ พร้อมความสะดวกที่มากกว่าเดิมด้วย ระบบหัวหมุนล็อกความกระชับ 🔄
พื้นที่หน้าเท้ากว้างขึ้น ลดแรงกดทับและการบีบรัด ให้ความรู้สึกสบายและเคลื่อนไหวได้อย่างเป็นธรรมชาติ
ปรับความกระชับได้ง่ายและรวดเร็ว เพียงหมุนก็ล็อกความกระชับ เพียงดึงก็ปลดล็อค
ลิ้นรองเท้าและ Upper แบบชิ้นเดียว โอบรับรูปเท้าอย่างพอดี สวมใส่ง่าย พร้อมความกระชับที่ไม่กดรัด
พื้นโฟมน้ำหนักเบา ให้สัมผัสนุ่ม ซับแรงกระแทกและคืนตัวได้ดี เพื่อความสบายในทุกการเคลื่อนไหว
เสริม TPU Stabilizer ขนาดกว้างพิเศษ ช่วยลดการบิดตัวของพื้นรองเท้า เพิ่มความมั่นคงขณะออกตัว หยุด และเปลี่ยนทิศทาง
แผ่นคาร์บอนดีไซน์ใหม่ ออกแบบตามสรีรศาสตร์ ขณะเคลื่อนไหวปรับโค้งเข้ากับฝ่าเท้า ทำงานร่วมกับ NitroMatrix ให้ทั้งความนุ่มและการรองรับแรงกระแทก
ดอกยางแบบแบ่งโซน รองรับทั้งการออกตัว การหยุด และเปลี่ยนทิศทาง เพิ่มการยึดเกาะและความมั่นใจในทุกการเคลื่อนไหว
Forefoot type : Comfort fit / Standard fit
Feature : NitroMatrix / EFFORTLESS FIT / MULTI-DIRECTIONAL TRACTION QUICK START CONTROLLED STOP

name: VS711S ZORO
lines: - Composite Cushioning Midsole ออกแบบเพื่อช่วยดูดซับแรงกระแทกจากการลงเท้า ด้วยคุณสมบัติ Energy Return ที่ช่วยสะสมและคืนพลังได้อย่างมีประสิทธิภาพ ทำให้การออกตัว เด้ง และตอบสนองได้ทันที
- Energy Cushioning System ซับแรงกระแทกและส่งกลับแรง เพื่อการออกที่รวดเร็ว เด้ง และคล่องตัวมากขึ้น
- Cushion & Store ซับแรงกระแทก และช่วยเพิ่มการเด้งกลับ
- Release & Rebound ช่วยส่งแรง เสมือนแรงดีดของสปริง ทำให้ออกตัวได้อย่างรวดเร็ว
- Wide & Secure Fit ออกแบบโดยหัวรองเท้าโอบกระชับ รองรับรูปเท้าได้ดียิ่งขึ้น ทำให้การเคลื่อนไหวคล่องตัวและมั่นคงทุกจังหวะ
- Reinforced Toe Protection เสริมความแข็งแรงบริเวณปลายเท้า เสริมวัสดุป้องกันในจุดที่เสียดสีบ่อย ทำให้รองเท้ามีความทนทานมากขึ้น
- Breathable Secure Fit Upper ผลิตจากผ้าตาข่าย Sandwich Mesh ทำให้การระบายอากาศได้ดี ลดความอับชิ้นระหว่างการเล่น และการออกแบบที่มีความกระชับทำให้เคลื่อนไหวได้อย่างมั่นใจ
- Carbon Fiber บริเวณกลางฝ่าเท้า เพิ่มความแข็งแรงของโครงสร้าง รองรับอุ้งเท้าอย่างมั่นคง ลดการบิดตัวของรองเท้าขณะเคลื่อนไหว เพื่อการทรงตัวที่ดีขึ้นในทุกจังหวะเร่ง หยุด และเปลี่ยนทิศทาง
- Multi-Directional Grip พื้นรองเท้าออกแบบโดยแบ่งโซนตามลักษณะการเคลื่อนไหว ช่วยเพิ่มประสิทธิภาพในการยึดเกาะ สามารถเคลื่อนไหวได้อย่างมั่นใจ
- Durable Outsole แต่ละพื้นที่ของ outsole ถูกออกแบบให้เหมาะกับการลงน้ำหนักและเคลื่อนที่ในทิศทางที่แตกต่างกันระหว่างการเล่น ลดการสึกของพื้นรองรับการใช้งานได้อย่างต่อเนื่อง
- U-Shape Heel Support ส้นรองเท้า ทรง U-Shape ช่วยโอบรับและล๊อคข้อเท้าให้แน่นกระชับ เพิ่มความมั่นใจในการเคลื่อนไหว ลดการขยับของเท้าภายในรองเท้า
Feature : Composite Cushioning Midsole / Energy Cushioning System / Breathable Secure Fit Upper / Carbon Fiber

name: VS2300S
lines: VS2300S รองเท้ากีฬาแบดมินตันสำหรับเด็ก สนุกได้เต็มที่ทุกการเคลื่อนไหว พร้อมความสบายและซัพพอร์ตที่ออกแบบมาเพื่อเด็ก ๆ โดยเฉพาะ
ดีไซน์สดใส ใส่ง่าย พร้อมลุยทั้งวัน ไม่ว่าจะซ้อม เล่นกีฬา หรือทำกิจกรรมโปรด
มีให้เลือก 2 สี 2 สไตล์
พร้อมเติมสีสันให้ทุกก้าวไปกับ VS2300S
- Automatic Lacing Device ปรับความกระชับได้ง่ายและรวดเร็ว
- TPU ขึ้นรูป ช่วยเสริมโครงสร้างรองเท้าให้มั่นคงและไม่เสียทรงง่าย
- VS-REBOUND ช่วยรองรับแรงกระแทกและคืนตัวได้ดี
- Carbon Fiber ช่วยเสริมความมั่นคง ลดการบิดตัวของเท้า
- 2 in 1 Midsole เพิ่มความนุ่มและการรองรับแรงกระแทก
- Non-Marking Outsole ยึดเกาะพื้นได้ดี พร้อมความแข็งแรงสำหรับทุกการเคลื่อนไหว
- สี : WP ขาวเขียว / WG ขาวชมพู

name: VS6001
lines: รองเท้าแบดมินตัน VENSON รุ่น VS6001
เบา นุ่ม และซัพพอร์ตครบ พร้อมรับทุกจังหวะพุ่ง หยุด และเปลี่ยนทิศทาง ให้คุณเคลื่อนที่ได้คล่อง สนุก และมั่นใจกว่าเดิม
โดดเด่นด้วย เบสสีขาวคลีน เติมดีเทลสีสันให้เลือกถึง 3 สี 3 มู้ด
ไม่ว่าจะสายสดใส สายคูล หรือสายเท่ ก็เลือกคู่ที่ใช่ แล้วลงสนามในสไตล์ของคุณ
- U-SHAPE (3.0) : ดีไซน์หน้าเท้ากว้าง สวมใส่สบาย ลดการบีบรัดขณะใช้งาน
- Dynamic Flow Foam : ช่วยรองรับแรงกระแทก และลดความล้าระหว่างการเล่น
- NON-MARKING Outsole : พื้นรองเท้ายึดเกาะดี ทนทาน รองรับทุกการเคลื่อนไหว
- KEVLAR + ANTI-TORSION PLATE : เสริมความแข็งแรงและช่วยลดแรงบิดขณะเคลื่อนที่
- TPU Mesh Fabric ผ้าตาข่ายเสริมวัสดุ TPU เพิ่มความแข็งแรง คงรูปได้ดี และช่วยลดการเสียทรง
- Sandwich Mesh Technology โครงสร้างผ้าตาข่ายหลายชั้น ให้สัมผัสนุ่ม ยืดหยุ่น และระบายอากาศได้ดี
- Extra Side Support : ช่วยเพิ่มความมั่นคงและเสถียรภาพในการเคลื่อนไหว
Forefoot type : U-Shape 3.0 หน้ากว้าง
Upper : TPU Mesh Fabric / Sandwich Mesh Technology
Feature : Dynamic Flow Foam / Carbon Fiber / U-Shape 3.0

name: VS6002
lines: เปิดตัวรองเท้ารุ่นใหม่ล่าสุดจาก VENSON VS6002 ที่อัปเกรดทั้งความ นุ่ม แน่น และเด้งกว่าเดิม  พร้อมเทคโนโลยีใหม่ที่ช่วย รองรับแรงกระแทก น้ำหนักเบา และเสริมความมั่นใจในทุกจังหวะการเคลื่อนไหว สัมผัสความแตกต่างตั้งแต่ก้าวแรก คล่องตัวขึ้นทุกสเต็ป ใส่สบายแบบซัพพอร์ตเต็มเท้า ทั้งเปลี่ยนทิศ หยุดพุ่ง กระโดด หรือสไลด์ ก็มั่นใจได้ตลอดเกม
- Dynamic Flow Foam วัสดุมีน้ำหนักเบาแต่ให้แรงสปริงและซัพพอร์ตแรงกระแทกได้อย่างดีเยี่ยม
- Carbon Fiber : พิ่มความแข็งแรงให้รองเท้าบริเวณฝ่าเท้า ป้องกันการบิดตัวของเท้าขณะเคลื่อนไหว และลดอุบัติเหตุที่อาจเกิดขึ้น
- Non Marking Rubber : พื้นยางกันลื่นดีไซน์ใหม่ ทนต่อการสึกหรอ เสริมความหนาและความนุ่ม ช่วยให้ทรงตัวและยึดเกาะพื้นได้ยอดเยี่ยม
- Durable PU Leather : ทนทานต่อการลอกล่อน และรองรับการใช้งานหนักได้ดีกว่าหนัง PU เกรดทั่วไป
- Tripple Layer Breathable Mesh : เพิ่มการยืดหยุ่นของรองเท้า ระบายอากาศได้ดี ทนทานไม่ย้วยง่าย
Forefoot type : U-Shape 3.0 หน้ากว้าง
Upper : Durable PU Leather / Tripple Layer Breathable Mesh
Feature : Dynamic Flow Foam / Carbon Fiber / U-Shape 3.0

lines: 𝗨-𝗦𝗛𝗔𝗣𝗘 (𝟯.𝟬) หน้าเท้ากว้าง > สีฟ้า  | สีน้ำเงิน  | สีขาว

name: VS178
lines: Flyknit Fabric ใช้เส้นใยที่แข็งแรงสูง น้ำหนักเบา บริเวณ Upper
เทคโนโลยีหุ้มส้น U-Shape โครงสร้างแข็งแรง ป้องกันไม่ให้เท้าเสียรูประหว่างเคลื่อนไหว
เทคโนโลยีปกป้องนิ้วเท้า ส่วนด้านหน้าของนิ้วเท้าได้รับการเสริมความแข็งแรง และความทนทาน ช่วยปกป้องฝ่าเท้าและห่อหุ้มนิ้วเท้าได้ดี
Automatic Lacing Device ทำหน้าที่ดึงและล็อกเชือกรองเท้าแบบหมุนอัตโนมัติ ล็อกเร็ว ปรับความแน่นไว สะดวกสบายมากยิ่งขึ้น ไม่ต้องผูก
พื้นกันลื่น Non-Marking ดีไซน์ใหม่ พื้นยางทนต่อการสึกหรอ เสริมความหนาและความนุ่ม
โครงสร้างโฟมEVA มีความยืดหยุ่นสูง ตอบสนองเร็วขึ้น ช่วยดูดซับแรงกระแทกได้อย่างมีประสิทธิภาพ
VS-Rebound ลดแรงกระแทก และเด้งกลับได้ดี
ระบบ “N-type” ป้องกันพื้นเสียรูป และช่วยให้ด้านข้างไม่ลื่นไถลขณะวิ่งหรือกระโดด
แผ่นคาร์บอนไฟเบอร์ เพิ่มความแข็งแรงให้รองเท้าบริเวณฝ่าเท้า ป้องกันการบิดตัวของเท้าขณะเคลื่อนไหว

The upper is built with a single primary piece which is a combination of the Durable Skin Light, a strong and lightweight material, and the Double Raschel Mesh, a highly breathable fabric. The two materials are fused together using a vacuum-pressing method which enables the upper to be built with less material.

The grip pattern of the sole has been redesigned creating the RADIAL BLADE SOLE. Resulting in a grip that supports quick dashes and sudden stops.

By improving shock absorption, our POWER CUSHION+ technology transforms impact into energy. A 28%* increase in shock absorption and a 62%** increase in repulsion when compared to the standard EVA materials.

The sole of the AERUS Z is built with Power Graphite Sheet, a carbon sheet that prevents twisting of the foot and improves stability during the most strenuous of movements. Working together with POWER CUSHION +, the absorbed impact power is converted into a propulsive force to help propel you into your next step.

lines: Brand New for 2024!! Introducing the latest version of the world's lightest badminton shoe in the world in a new stunning color.

Introducing the new Power Cushion AERUS Z2 which achieves both lightness and stability. This new 4th-generation model in the vastly successful Aerus series is an improvement over the Yonex Aerus Z model.  It is the lightest ever badminton shoe from Yonex, weighing just around 240 grams.
The new AERUS Z2 is both light and stable.

The sole is manufactured using Feather Light X, a material that is 12% lighter in weight while generating more repulsion than the previous AERUS models. A key ingredient to stability is a reliable grip. RADIAL BLADE SOLE is implemented to provide the ultimate grip.

With a new seamless upper design, comprised of 100% recycled materials, the Durable Skin Light and Double Russel Mesh bring less weight with a better fit, flexibility, and breathability – Easy on your feet as well as the environment. With the POWER CUSHION+ and improved 3D Power Graphite Drive, the AERUS Z2 is not only light stable and eco-friendly but also converts the impact of each step into repulsion and power for the next.
The new AERUS Z is now available in men’s, women’s, and wide models, giving players more options. It is also accompanied by its affordable counterpart, AERUS X, and the junior model, AERUS JR.
FEATHER LIGHT X is Yonex’s lightest midsole material and is one of the key technologies in making the AERUS Z2 lighter while providing smooth, quick footwork.

The upper is built with a single primary piece which is a combination of the Durable Skin Light, a strong and lightweight material, and the Double Raschel Mesh, a highly breathable fabric. The two materials are fused together using a vacuum-pressing method which enables the upper to be built with less material.

The grip pattern of the sole has been redesigned creating the RADIAL BLADE SOLE. By finely arranging a windmill shape that combines areas with large and small indentations, the weight of the shoe is dispersed, and the grip is improved by approximately 3%*. Resulting in a grip that supports quick dashes and sudden stops.

The AERUS Z features a specially shaped wedge of POWER CUSHION+ in the heel designed specifically to absorb shock associated with the footwork of badminton. By improving shock absorption, our POWER CUSHION+ technology transforms impact into energy. A 28%* increase in shock absorption and a 62%** increase in repulsion when compared to the standard EVA materials.

The sole of the AERUS Z2 is built with Power Graphite Sheet, a carbon sheet that prevents twisting of the foot and improves stability during the most strenuous of movements. Working together with POWER CUSHION +, the absorbed impact power is converted into a propulsive force to help propel you into your next step.

Working together with POWER CUSHION +, the absorbed impact power is converted into a propulsive force to help propel you into your next step.

The advanced midsole ensures cushioning, high rebound, and impeccable landings, while multilayered mesh and synthetic materials enhance durability. The external brace in lateral sections and heel delivers unwavering support and unmatched balance, allowing you to dominate the court

name: Saga Lite 8
lines: Crafted using high-strength TPU material, the Li-Ning Saga Lite 8 helps you achieve swift changes in direction, speed and control. It is built with a non-marking sole and its cushioned midsole provides outstanding support and traction, enhancing footwork and delivering controlled, faster play on the court.

name: Ranger Lite Z2
lines: The Ranger Lite Z2's PerfectFit Upper ensures secure foot support for agility, its EnergyReturning Mid offers efficient shock absorption and energy transfer for endurance, the MaxGrip Sole with TPU Insert guarantees superior court traction and ankle stability, and the cushioned EVA Sole Board delivers lasting comfort and durability, making it an ideal choice for competitive badminton players

name: Gladiator
lines: Take your badminton game to the next level with The Gladiator Shoes by Li-Ning. This performance shoe features LI-NING CLOUD technology in the responsive midsole to absorb shock and unleash energy with each step. The engineered outsole combines traction and durability for stability during intense play. Probar Loc technology locks your foot in place to enable swift, precise footwork. With innovative technology that enhances your aggressive style of play, The Gladiator gives you the edge you need to conquer the court by reacting quicker, jumping higher, and moving faster point after point.

name: Mirage Pro
lines: The Mirage Pro, featuring BOOM FIBER technology, ensures exceptional flexibility and robust durability, enabling swift, precise movements on the court. The ultra-lightweight design at just 265 grams enhances speed and agility during play. LI-NING CLOUD PLUS midsole offers superior rebound and comfort for energetic jumps and landings. VAJRA SKIN adds to the durability while ensuring comfort, perfect for enduring intense badminton sessions

name: Ultra Fly III
lines: Take your court game to new heights in the Li-Ning Ultra Fly 3. Weighing just 310g, this lightweight shoe features a breathable upper combining TPU and mesh for superior comfort. The Phylon midsole and rubber outsole deliver responsive cushioning and traction to keep you moving fast and fluid. With strategic support and an agile feel, the Ultra Fly 3 gives you the edge to fly across the court.

name: Blade Max
lines: Step into greatness with the Blade Max, our premium badminton shoe built for champions. Trusted by international players, this shoe features Li-Ning's top-tier technology such as Probar Loc, Tuff Tip, and Boom midsole to improve your performance on the court. The Blade Max is designed for optimum support and efficiency, minimizing energy waste during play and allowing you to retain peak athletic performance. The Blade Max badminton shoe will help you elevate your game and overcome the competition with confidence and style.

name: Ultra Max
lines: The Ultra Max non-marking shoe is designed for high-intensity activities, making it ideal for long games and intense training sessions. The midsole provides cushioning, high rebound and better landing. The shoe body and tongue are made of multilayered mesh and synthetic materials, improving its durability. The external brace in the lateral sections and heel area adds extra stiffness and support for better balance, so you can exude power & move with confidence.

name: Saga II SE
lines: Presenting the Saga 2 SE, the pinnacle of performance footwear designed for elite players. The Saga 2 SE features VAJRA SKIN, a lightweight, highly abrasion-resistant material that offers improved durability and breathability. The Probar Loc technology provides optimal midfoot support, minimizing twisting and ensuring stability during intense rallies. Its well-cushioned footbed with sweat-wicking properties ensures superior comfort, while Tuff RB technology enhances traction for smooth, fluid motion. The Boom Cushion system effectively dampens impact shocks, while the carbon fibre stability plate prevents needless twists and turns. The Tuff Tip in front preserves durability by preventing early wear, and the Heel Lock mechanism ensures stability during high jumps and sudden movements, making the Saga 2 SE the ideal badminton shoe.

name: Almighty V 2.0
lines: Introducing the all new  Almighty V 2.0, a perfect blend of flexibility, comfort, and breathability for today's athletes. This upgraded version of its predecessor, the Almighty V, features a ventilated top with a mesh design to maximize airflow, keeping your feet cool and dry. The shoe's highly flexible construction allows for unrestricted movement, enabling athletes to perform at their peak. With exceptional cushioning, the shoe offers unparalleled comfort with every step, making it the top choice for individuals who demand the best from their footwear.

name: Hunting
lines: The Hunting represents the epitome of innovative design and smart technology in badminton footwear. This shoe features a Boom Fiber Upper for maximum flexibility, resulting in a snug and adaptable fit. The Probar Loc Support system offers exceptional stability during intense movements, while the rubber outer Heel Brace enhances overall support for your heels. The Hunting also includes TUFF TIP, a wear-resistant toe cap material that reduces premature wear and extends the shoe's lifespan. The LIGHT FOAM midsole technology utilizes a high-performance olefin copolymer to produce finer, more uniform foam bubbles, resulting in reduced weight, increased flexibility, and enhanced durability. This combination of features makes the Hunting perfect for athletes seeking top performance, comfort, and longevity.

lines: Babolat Jet Tere Clay Men's Shoes [Grey/Aero]
The Jet Tere is designed for speed (Tere is Māori for speed). Thanks to its understated design and breathable mesh, you'll fly around the court enjoying how light, comfortable and agile this shoe is.

One of our skills is carefully observing the game and noting how players move. We've used this analysis to create our KPRS-X system, which protects your heel from sudden impact throughout training sessions and matches. The EVA foam insert has been sized and positioned to keep you protected whenever your heel strikes the ground.
We've worked with Michelin to create a sole made of a special kind of rubber for each court surface.
A Matryx piece on the forefoot gives extra support for lateral movements.
A very hard-wearing protective rubber piece covering the inner forefoot down to the toes for unrivalled upper durability.
The OrthoLite® insole is molded to hug the shape of the foot. The properties of the foam composition make for exceptional comfort, breathability and durability.
The entire heel zone is protected by EVA foam with less hardness to absorb shocks in any position.
A technology developed and patented by Babolat. The shape and composition of the materials used for the sole are segmented into 9 key pressure points for maximum responsiveness.
Michelin Premium rubber is the most durable composition ever developed. It offers increased resistance and optimal grip to meet the extreme demands of tennis footwork

lines: Babolat Propulse Junior All Court Shoes [Grey/Aero]

Inspired by the adult model, it provides an excellent balance of support, durability and comfort thanks to the strap in the midfoot, the protective piece in the forefoot and the Michelin sole designed to last on all court surfaces.
The Propulse Jr is the ideal shoe for young competitors who want to develop their game. The Power Belt is like a "seat belt" that keeps the foot secure even through the most demanding shots.
Because we're always thinking about comfort, we've given the Propulse Jr an EVA midsole and the Kompressor system to protect the ankle from sudden impact throughout training and matches.
We've worked with Michelin to create a sole made of a special kind of rubber for each court surface.
The Powerbelt is a wide strap that wraps around the midfoot and offers both exceptional lateral support and an almost tailored fit all around the foot.
A very hard-wearing protective rubber piece covering the inner forefoot down to the toes for unrivalled upper durability.
The properties of the foam composition mean that the OrthoLite® die cut insole provides exceptional comfort, breathability and durability.
TPR (Thermo Plastic Rubber) tube compression system positioned beneath the heel for exceptional shock absorption.
The Michelin rubber composition has proven its worth over the past 15 years and beyond, It offers a great combination of grip and durability to meet the extreme demands of tennis footwork.

name: Babolat Jet Mach 3 All Court Women's Shoes [French Blue]
lines: Our Jet Mach 3 takes our bestseller to a new level. Designed to keep you free to pinpoint your movements, the Jet Mach 3 is even lighter, more comfortable and stable thanks to the latest Matryx® technology. The Michelin sole has also been updated so it copes with every sudden start and stop, and really lasts.
The one-piece Matryx® EVO upper blends Aramid and Polyamid fibers for lightweight support and protection.
A soft, shock-absorbing EVA foam pad insole provides even foot protection, support, and excellent balance.
The EVA midsole is soft and responsive, while KPRS-X cushioning in the heel absorbs shock for greater foot protection.

The Michelin Performance outsole delivers superior traction and durability on all court surfaces. Made with Michelin Premium DIN 20 to increase durability and minimize wear and tear from tennis/pickleball movements.

At only 325g (for EU size 42.5) on the scales, we have designed Jet Mach III to fly on the court. By using a unique material, MATRYX EVO with its PAHT and Aramid threads positioned in specific areas, we were able to make the shoe ultra-light and abrasion-resistant without compromising on stability and support.

Because observation of the game and its movements is our core expertise, we have designed the KPRS-X system to protect your heels from impact throughout matches and training sessions. Its EVA foam insert has been placed and sized to protect you effectively at each heel attack.
By combining our expertise with Michelin’s, we offer players a dedicated sole for each surface with an adapted rubber formulation.
The Propulse Fury has a thicker grip, making it the most durable model of our range.
Michelin Premium rubber is the most durable composition ever developed. It offers increased resistance and optimal grip to meet the extreme demands of tennis footwork.

Matryx is an exclusive patented fabric developed in close collaboration between Babolat and technical fabric expert Chamatex. The EVO version is woven using the jacquard process which preserves the ‘Stability arch’ system and high-tenacity Aramide and Polyamide fibres. The thread diameter has been adapted and the monofilaments removed for increased suppleness/flexibility and comfort. Matryx® EVO technology was designed to offer the optimum compromise between comfort, support and durability.
The entire heel zone is protected by EVA foam with less hardness to absorb shocks in any position.

– Yonex Co., LTD is proud to announce the upcoming release of the new POWER CUSHION AERUS Z badminton shoes. The AERUS series are a lightweight series aimed at providing agile footwork for all players who like to stay light and on their toes.

The new AERUS Z achieves both lightness and stability. With each generation, the AERUS series prides itself on pushing the boundaries of lightness. This new 5th generation model is the lightest ever badminton shoe from Yonex, weighing in at just 240 grams per shoe*. These shoes are slimmed down by adopting a new sole made of Feather Light X, a material that is 12% lighter in weight, while generating more repulsion than the previous AERUS models. A key ingredient to stability is reliable grip. RADIAL BLADE SOLE is implemented to provide ultimate grip.

With a new seamless upper design, comprised of 100% recycled materials, the Durable Skin Light and Double Russel Mesh bring less weight with better fit, flexibility and breathability – Easy on your feet as well as the environment. With the POWER CUSHION+ and improved 3D Power Graphite Drive, the AERUS Z is not only light stable and eco-friendly, but also converts the impact of each step into repulsion and power for the next.

The new AERUS Z is now available in men’s, women’s and wide models, giving players more options. It is also accompanied by its affordable counterpart, AERUS X and junior model, AERUS JR. The POWER CUSHION AERUS X is designed as a comfortable lightweight model built with limited features. Those of which include the seamless upper design, POWER CUSHION and more. The new AERUS models are set to release on October 22nd.

The new AERUS Z will be sported on court by Olympic gold medalist, Carolina Marin (ESP), world No.2 men’s doubles, Marcus F. Gideon, World Tour Finals 2021 Champion, An Se Young (KOR) and 2022 Malaysian Open women’s singles champion, Ratchanok Intanon (THA).
*Measured with industry standard men’s 26.0 cm shoe.
FEATHER LIGHT X is Yonex’s lightest midsole material and is one of the key technologies  in making the AERUS Z lighter while providing smooth, fluid footwork.

The upper is built with a single primary piece which is a combination of the Durable Skin Light, a strong and lightweight material, and the Double Raschel Mesh, a highly breathable fabric. The two materials are fused together using a vacuum-pressing method which enables the upper to be built with less material.

The grip pattern of the sole has been redesigned creating the RADIAL BLADE SOLE. By finely arranging a windmill shape that combines areas with large and small indentations, the weight of the shoe is dispersed, and the grip is improved by approximately 3%*. Resulting in a grip that supports quick dashes and sudden stops.

The AERUS Z features a specially shaped wedge of POWER CUSHION+ in the heel designed specifically to absorb shock associated with the footwork of badminton. By improving shock absorption, our POWER CUSHION+ technology transforms impact into energy. A 28%* increase in shock absorption and a 62%** increase in repulsion when compared to the standard EVA materials.

The sole of the AERUS Z is built with Power Graphite Sheet, a carbon sheet that prevents twisting of the foot and improves stability during the most strenuous of movements. Working together with POWER CUSHION +, the absorbed impact power is converted into a propulsive force to help propel you into your next step.

With the POWER CUSHION+ and improved 3D Power Graphite Drive, the AERUS Z is not only light stable and eco-friendly, but also converts the impact of each step into repulsion and power for the next.

The new AERUS Z is now available in men’s, women’s and wide models, giving players more options. It is also accompanied by its affordable counterpart, AERUS X and junior model, AERUS JR. The POWER CUSHION AERUS X is designed as a comfortable lightweight model built with limited features. Those of which include the seamless upper design, POWER CUSHION and more. The new AERUS models are set to release on October 22nd.

The new AERUS Z will be sported on court by Olympic gold medalist, Carolina Marin (ESP), world No.2 men’s doubles, Marcus F. Gideon, World Tour Finals 2021 Champion, An Se Young (KOR) and 2022 Malaysian Open women’s singles champion, Ratchanok Intanon (THA).

The two materials are fused together using a vacuum-pressing method which enables the upper to be built with less material.

The grip pattern of the sole has been redesigned creating the RADIAL BLADE SOLE. By finely arranging a windmill shape that combines areas with large and small indentations, the weight of the shoe is dispersed, and the grip is improved by approximately 3%*. Resulting in a grip that supports quick dashes and sudden stops.

The AERUS Z features a specially shaped wedge of POWER CUSHION+ in the heel designed specifically to absorb shock associated with the footwork of badminton. By improving shock absorption, our POWER CUSHION+ technology transforms impact into energy. A 28%* increase in shock absorption and a 62%** increase in repulsion when compared to the standard EVA materials.

The sole of the AERUS Z is built with Power Graphite Sheet, a carbon sheet that prevents twisting of the foot and improves stability during the most strenuous of movements. Working together with POWER CUSHION +, the absorbed impact power is converted into a propulsive force to help propel you into your next step.

name: Yonex Power Cushion Aerus Z2 WIDE Men's Indoor - White/Green
lines: badminton shoe is an upscale model that combines the latest technologies to provide players with the performance, comfort and durability they demand. It features the following characteristics:
FEATHER LIGHT X is Yonex’s lightest midsole material and is one of the key technologies in making the AERUS Z lighter while providing smooth, fluid footwork.

The upper is built with a single primary piece which is a combination of the Durable Skin Light, a strong and lightweight material, and the Double Raschel Mesh, a highly breathable fabric. The two materials are fused together using a vacuum-pressing method which enables the upper to be built with less material.

The grip pattern of the sole has been redesigned creating the RADIAL BLADE SOLE. By finely arranging a windmill shape that combines areas with large and small indentations, the weight of the shoe is dispersed, and the grip is improved by approximately 3%*. Resulting in a grip that supports quick dashes and sudden stops.

The AERUS Z features a specially shaped wedge of POWER CUSHION+ in the heel designed specifically to absorb shock associated with the footwork of badminton. By improving shock absorption, our POWER CUSHION+ technology transforms impact into energy. A 28%* increase in shock absorption and a 62%** increase in repulsion when compared to the standard EVA materials.

The sole of the AERUS Z is built with Power Graphite Sheet, a carbon sheet that prevents twisting of the foot and improves stability during the most strenuous of movements. Working together with POWER CUSHION +, the absorbed impact power is converted into a propulsive force to help propel you into your next step.

lines: The Yonex Aerus Z2 badminton shoe is an upscale model that combines the latest technologies to provide players with the performance, comfort and durability they demand. It features the following characteristics:
FEATHER LIGHT X is Yonex’s lightest midsole material and is one of the key technologies  in making the AERUS Z lighter while providing smooth, fluid footwork.

The upper is built with a single primary piece which is a combination of the Durable Skin Light, a strong and lightweight material, and the Double Raschel Mesh, a highly breathable fabric. The two materials are fused together using a vacuum-pressing method which enables the upper to be built with less material.

The grip pattern of the sole has been redesigned creating the RADIAL BLADE SOLE. By finely arranging a windmill shape that combines areas with large and small indentations, the weight of the shoe is dispersed, and the grip is improved by approximately 3%*. Resulting in a grip that supports quick dashes and sudden stops.

The AERUS Z features a specially shaped wedge of POWER CUSHION+ in the heel designed specifically to absorb shock associated with the footwork of badminton. By improving shock absorption, our POWER CUSHION+ technology transforms impact into energy. A 28%* increase in shock absorption and a 62%** increase in repulsion when compared to the standard EVA materials.

The sole of the AERUS Z is built with Power Graphite Sheet, a carbon sheet that prevents twisting of the foot and improves stability during the most strenuous of movements. Working together with POWER CUSHION +, the absorbed impact power is converted into a propulsive force to help propel you into your next step.

name: Yonex Power Cushion Aerus Z2L Women's Indoor Navy Blue
lines: The Yonex Aerus Z2 badminton shoe is an upscale model that combines the latest technologies to provide players with the performance, comfort and durability they demand. It features the following characteristics:
FEATHER LIGHT X is Yonex’s lightest midsole material and is one of the key technologies  in making the AERUS Z lighter while providing smooth, fluid footwork.

The upper is built with a single primary piece which is a combination of the Durable Skin Light, a strong and lightweight material, and the Double Raschel Mesh, a highly breathable fabric. The two materials are fused together using a vacuum-pressing method which enables the upper to be built with less material.

The grip pattern of the sole has been redesigned creating the RADIAL BLADE SOLE. By finely arranging a windmill shape that combines areas with large and small indentations, the weight of the shoe is dispersed, and the grip is improved by approximately 3%*. Resulting in a grip that supports quick dashes and sudden stops.

The AERUS Z features a specially shaped wedge of POWER CUSHION+ in the heel designed specifically to absorb shock associated with the footwork of badminton. By improving shock absorption, our POWER CUSHION+ technology transforms impact into energy. A 28%* increase in shock absorption and a 62%** increase in repulsion when compared to the standard EVA materials.

The sole of the AERUS Z is built with Power Graphite Sheet, a carbon sheet that prevents twisting of the foot and improves stability during the most strenuous of movements. Working together with POWER CUSHION +, the absorbed impact power is converted into a propulsive force to help propel you into your next step.

lines: The Asics Netburner Professional FF2 is a high-performance netball shoe for players who need speed, stability and comfort in the same package. Lightweight and responsive, with an outsole tuned for the pivot work netball demands, it is a long-standing choice among serious court players.

Netball punishes footwear in a very particular way — hard landings, sudden stops and a lot of rotation on a planted foot. The Netburner Professional FF2 answers that with a responsive midsole that returns energy rather than absorbing it, and an outsole pattern that lets the foot turn cleanly instead of gripping and jarring the knee. The mesh upper keeps heat down through heated exchanges while the overlays stop the foot sliding across the footbed on lateral sprints.

Combining light weight with genuine court stability, the FF2 minimises fatigue while maximising directional control. Players get quicker transitions from defence to attack, steadier pivots through rapid changes of direction, and cooler, drier feet thanks to the breathable mesh — real advantages when the game turns on a single step.

The Netburner Professional FF2 delivers a proven blend of light weight, breathability and pivot-ready stability. For players chasing peak performance on court, it offers responsive comfort that helps you move faster, react sooner and stay comfortable for the full four quarters.

name: Hundred Hypercourt Adapt Badminton Shoes (White/Black/Orange/Blue)
lines: God of Sports Expert Verdict on Hundred Hypercourt Adapt Badminton Shoes:

The Hundred Hypercourt Adapt Badminton Shoes are built around one idea: a fit that stays locked from the first step to the last rally. Hundred designed the shoe to hold the foot securely in place, so it responds straight away to sudden stops, lateral pushes and changes of direction, without the foot sliding around inside.

The fit comes from two things working together. The Adapt Dial System replaces traditional laces with two dials on the side of the shoe that tighten a cable lacing system, so you can set exactly how firmly the shoe holds your foot with a quick turn. Around it, the upper is Flyknit mesh, which wraps around the foot and adapts to its shape rather than forcing the foot into a rigid shell. Underneath, Hundred pairs an X Cushion midsole with an Active Grip non-marking outsole, and a heel brace keeps the rearfoot steady when you land and push off.

At around 330 grams, it sits on the lighter side for a supportive court shoe. The design favours stability and responsiveness over soft, deep cushioning: the shoe feels close to the court and quick to react, which suits players who move fast and change direction often.

The Hundred Hypercourt Adapt Badminton Shoes are for intermediate to advanced players who want a secure, responsive fit and value stability over maximum cushioning. Players who need plenty of soft cushioning for heavy landings, or who play long sessions on hard floors, should consider a more cushioned shoe.
Technology Breakdown of the Hundred Hypercourt Adapt Badminton Shoes:
Adapt Dial System — precise, lace-free lockdown:

Two dials on the side of the shoe tighten a cable lacing system in place of traditional laces. A quick turn sets the fit exactly as firm as you want it, and there are no laces to come undone or loosen mid-match, so the hold you set in the warm-up stays the same in the last rally.
Flyknit mesh upper — a fit that adapts to your foot:
The knit upper moulds to the shape of your foot and holds it snugly, so there is no internal slip when you stop or push sideways. It is also light and breathable, which helps in humid Indian halls.
A reinforced heel keeps the back of the foot locked in place on landings, lunges and recovery steps, adding stability where fast movement puts the most strain on the ankle.
X Cushion midsole — shock absorption with a responsive feel:
Hundred's X Cushion midsole absorbs impact and returns energy, while keeping the shoe low and responsive rather than soft and sinking.
Active Grip outsole — traction on every push-off:
The non-marking rubber outsole is designed for grip on indoor courts, so the shoe holds firmly on lunges and sharp changes of direction.

name: Victor A170 IN Badminton Shoes (Navy Blue)
lines: God of Sports Expert Verdict on Victor A170 IN Badminton Shoes:

The Victor A170 IN Badminton Shoes is the entry point into Victor's All Around shoe range in India, built for beginners and recreational players who need a proper badminton shoe for the first time. It keeps the construction simple: a PU leather and mesh upper, an EVA midsole with Victor's ENERGYMAX cushioning, a nylon sheet under the midfoot and a rubber outsole made for indoor courts.

What matters most for a new player is that it is a court shoe, not a running shoe. Running shoes have soft, high heels and treads designed for forward motion, which makes lateral movement on a badminton court unstable and slippery. The A170 IN sits lower, grips the court surface and supports the side-to-side steps that every rally involves.

The nylon sheet is the key support feature at this level. It stiffens the midfoot so the shoe does not twist when you change direction quickly, while the EVA and ENERGYMAX midsole takes the edge off landings and lunges during regular practice.

Be realistic about what an entry-level shoe is for. It is designed for learning, coaching sessions and recreational games, not for daily high-intensity training or competitive play. Players who are moving up to frequent, longer sessions will get more cushioning and support from Victor's higher-tier All Around models.
Technology Breakdown of the Victor A170 IN Badminton Shoes:

The EVA foam absorbs impact on landing, and ENERGYMAX adds Victor's cushioning layer for a little more comfort on lunges and recovery steps. It is tuned for regular recreational play rather than heavy training loads.
A firm nylon sheet under the arch helps the shoe resist twisting during quick direction changes, which keeps footwork stable and reduces the strain on the foot.

The rubber sole is made for indoor badminton courts and gives dependable traction for starting, stopping and changing direction. Keep it for indoor use, as outdoor surfaces wear the grip down quickly.
PU leather and mesh upper — support with airflow:
PU leather panels hold the foot in place during lateral movement, while the mesh areas let heat escape through longer practice sessions.

name: Hundred Hyper Armour Badminton Shoes (Black/Lime/Orange)
lines: God of Sports Expert Verdict on Hundred Hyper Armour Badminton Shoes:

The Hundred Hyper Armour Badminton Shoes is Hundred's shoe for the long session. Hundred describes it as "the choice for the long run", and the whole design brief is consistency: a structured upper that holds its shape and keeps the foot locked in, a midsole built to keep absorbing impact well into a third game, and a non-marking outsole that grips on both baseline push-offs and flat lunges to the net.

At 340 grams per shoe, it is not a featherweight speed shoe. The extra structure is deliberate: the upper is built not to loosen as a session goes on, so the shoe you lace up in the first rally feels much the same in the last. That makes it better suited to players who log long, regular training hours than to players chasing the lightest possible shoe.

Hundred makes the shoe in India and offers it in UK 6 to UK 11, in Black/Lime/Orange, White/Light Blue/Black and Blue/White/Navy. Hundred does not publish named cushioning or upper technologies for this model, so the verdict here is based on what the shoe is designed to do rather than on technology labels.

The Hundred Hyper Armour Badminton Shoes is for intermediate players who train several times a week and want a dependable, durable shoe that stays consistent across a long session and across weeks of use. Players who want a lighter, faster-feeling shoe, or Hundred's more specialised support features, should look at the Hyper Court or Hyper Spike.
Technology Breakdown of the Hundred Hyper Armour Badminton Shoes:
Structured upper — lockdown that does not fade:

Hundred builds the upper to stay structured and hug the foot. On court, that means the foot stays planted over the footbed during sharp direction changes, and the fit does not loosen as the session goes on.
Long-lasting midsole cushioning — protection late in the session:

The midsole is designed to keep absorbing impact well into the third game. That consistency matters for players who train for long periods, when tired legs land heavier on every lunge and recovery step.
Non-marking grip outsole — traction on push-off and lunge:
The non-marking rubber outsole is designed to hold whether you are pushing off from the baseline or lunging flat to the net, without leaving marks on indoor courts.
At 340 grams per shoe, the Hyper Armour trades a little lightness for structure and durability, which is the right trade for heavy training loads.

Players who train several times a week:
The shoe is built to stay consistent through long sessions and repeated use, which is what heavy training wears out first.
Intermediate club players who want one dependable pair:
A structured, durable all-court shoe that does not need replacing after a few months of regular play.

The cushioning is designed to keep working deep into a session, when it matters most.

name: Li-Ning All Round Badminton Shoes (Standard White/Violet Tulip)
lines: God of Sports Expert Verdict on Li-Ning All Round Badminton Shoes:

The All Round sits at the accessible end of Li-Ning's badminton shoe range, built as a single do-everything shoe for a club player who needs one pair that covers net lunges, mid-court transitions and rearcourt retreats without specialising in any one of them.

At under 300g per shoe, it's one of the lighter options in Li-Ning's India shoe line-up, and pairs that low weight with an energy-return EVA midsole that gives a bit of spring back on quick direction changes rather than feeling dead underfoot.

It shares its all-court, do-it-all brief with Li-Ning's higher-tier Halberd Strike, but without that shoe's LN Cloud cushioning or price tag, making the All Round the entry point into Li-Ning's badminton footwear rather than a flagship.

This is the shoe for an intermediate club player who wants a genuine badminton-specific shoe, non-marking outsole included, over a generic training sneaker, and isn't yet logging the daily high-volume sessions that would justify a heavier-cushioned model.
Energy-Return EVA Midsole — spring back on push-off:
The foam compresses on landing and releases that stored energy back on your next step, which takes some of the strain out of the repeated lunges and recovery steps a badminton rally demands.
Non-Marking Rubber Outsole — grip without scuffing the court:
A grippy tread pattern holds on wooden and synthetic indoor courts through sudden direction changes, while the non-marking compound keeps black scuff marks off shared court surfaces.
Mesh Upper with Synthetic Overlay — breathability with structure:
Mesh panels let heat and moisture escape during a long session, while synthetic overlays around the toe and midfoot hold the shoe's shape through repeated lateral movement.
Shoe Finder — Is This Right for You?
Club players who want one all-court shoe:
if your game moves between the net, mid-court and rearcourt rather than living in one zone, the All Round's balanced, lightweight build is made exactly for that.
Intermediate players stepping up from a generic sports shoe:
a badminton-specific non-marking outsole and lighter build hold up to lateral movement far better than a running or cross-training shoe ever will.
Budget-conscious buyers who still want a genuine Li-Ning badminton shoe:
it gives you the brand's core badminton construction — mesh upper, non-marking grip, energy-return midsole — without paying for a flagship cushioning system you may not need yet.
Not for you if you train daily at high intensity:

players doing heavy daily footwork drills or long tournament days will feel the All Round's cushioning run thin well before a session ends. Li-Ning's Ranger Force is built for exactly that kind of load, and the Halberd Strike suits a player who wants more premium cushioning for switching between attack and defence.
Feet with a low or collapsed arch that can roll inward (overpronate) under load, which on a badminton court shows up most during lunges and direction changes.
Shoes with built-in arch support or a firm medial midsole that resists rolling inward, plus a stable heel counter.
All Round for Flat Feet: Moderate match.

The energy-return midsole is forgiving underfoot but doesn't include dedicated arch support, so a flat-footed player who overpronates noticeably may want to add an aftermarket insole rather than rely on the stock midsole alone.
A high arch reduces the foot's natural shock absorption, which can transfer more impact up through the foot and ankle on hard landings.
Extra midsole cushioning and a flexible forefoot that lets the foot splay naturally on landing.

The energy-return EVA midsole adds a layer of cushioning that a high-arched foot benefits from, softening the repeated jump-landings and lunges of a full session.

The midsole's cushioning helps on landings, but without a dedicated supportive footbed, a player managing active plantar fasciitis should consult a podiatrist or physiotherapist and consider an orthotic insole before committing to long sessions in this shoe.
Sensitivity or past injury around the heel and Achilles tendon, aggravated by shoes with a stiff or poorly padded heel counter during the sudden stops and lunges badminton demands.
A padded, well-shaped heel collar and a slightly raised, cushioned heel to reduce Achilles strain.

lines: God of Sports Expert Verdict on Victor P9200 III TD Badminton Shoes:

Victor P9200 III TD Badminton Shoes is the training-oriented variant of Victor's flagship P9200 III — a shoe that has earned its reputation as one of the most comprehensively cushioned professional badminton shoes available in India. The TD (Training Day) distinction is meaningful and practical: the TD uses U-Shape 2.5, Victor's softer, more forgiving sole, rather than the U-Shape 3.0 found on the standard competitive P9200 III. This makes the TD the right choice for players who train frequently — multiple sessions per week — where the additional comfort of U-Shape 2.5 across extended wear matters more than the marginally sharper court feedback of 3.0. The HYPEREVA midsole, Drop-In Midsole with Tri-Arch support, and VSR rubber outsole are shared across both variants, meaning the TD delivers the full P9200 III performance platform at a more training-friendly specification.

HYPEREVA is the technology that defines the P9200 III TD's character on court. Victor's most advanced midsole foam, HYPEREVA achieves what previous-generation EVA foams cannot: genuine softness on landing without the dead, energy-absorbing compression that makes standard EVA shoes feel sluggish after repeated impacts. HYPEREVA is soft and bouncy simultaneously — it absorbs the impact of jump landings and smash approaches, then returns energy toward the next movement. The Drop-In Midsole construction — insole and midsole as one integrated unit carrying Tri-Arch support across all three natural foot arches — delivers this energy return and arch support from a structurally more durable platform than conventional two-layer constructions. The result is outstanding cushioning and shock absorption, with overall comfort among the best in the Victor range.

The honest performance trade-off worth communicating to Indian buyers: the P9200 III TD's HYPEREVA cushioning is specifically excellent for the deep forward strides and landing impacts of singles play — jump smash landings, forehand lunge approaches. Beast Badminton's review noted the heel sits relatively low and the ankle area is soft rather than firm-locked. Players who specifically want tight, locked-in ankle feel for fast doubles exchanges may find the P9200 III TD's cushioning-first approach slightly less secure than firmer ankle-support alternatives like the Victor A970TD. The TD is optimised for cushioning comfort, not maximum ankle lockdown.

For Indian club players, the P9200 III TD's HYPEREVA cushioning is particularly relevant in a country where most players train on hard PU synthetic courts rather than the sprung wooden floors common in Japan and Europe. PU synthetic courts are harder underfoot — each landing transmits more force to knees, ankles, and the lower back than a sprung floor does. HYPEREVA's superior shock absorption specifically addresses this: the Drop-In Midsole's Tri-Arch support distributes landing impact across the full arch rather than concentrating it at the heel, and HYPEREVA's energy return ensures the player pushes off confidently for the next shot rather than sinking into a dead midsole. For Indian players who train 3–5 sessions per week on hard synthetic courts and experience knee or ankle fatigue, the Victor P9200 III TD Badminton Shoes is a meaningful investment in long-term joint health.

Soft, bouncy, and structurally durable — the combination that previous-generation foams could not achieve. Delivers the most comfortable landing experience in Victor's shoe range, specifically beneficial for players who make repeated jump landings from smashes and jump-clear approaches.

name: Hundred Hyper Spike Badminton Shoes (White/Blue/Orange/Lime)
lines: God of Sports Expert Verdict on Hundred Hyper Spike Badminton Shoes:

The Hundred Hyper Spike represents what is possible when a badminton-specific Indian sports brand designs a shoe for the Indian badminton context — not adapted from a global template, but built from the ground up for Indian court conditions, Indian player physiology, and the Indian competitive badminton price point. The result is a shoe that competes technically with mid-to-upper range offerings from Yonex and Victor while being priced more accessibly and manufactured domestically.

The Support Plate is the Hyper Spike's most distinctive feature when compared to competitors at similar price points, and it is genuinely performance-relevant. name: Victor A301 IN Badminton Shoes (Medieval Blue)
lines: God of Sports Expert Verdict on Victor A301 IN Badminton Shoes:

Most Indian players begin their badminton journey in running shoes. This is understandable — running shoes are what most people already own — but it is a genuine performance and safety handicap. Running shoes are engineered for forward linear movement, with cushioning profiles that push energy back in a forward direction and soles that grip in a straight line. Badminton requires constant lateral movement, sudden direction changes, and repeated vertical jumping and landing. Running shoes actively work against these movement patterns, providing poor lateral stability, inadequate multi-directional grip, and cushioning that fatigues the foot during extended court sessions.

Victor A301 IN Badminton Shoes addresses every one of these limitations. The non-marking rubber outsole grips for lateral slides and direction changes. The ENERGYMAX + EVA midsole cushions vertical impact on landings and provides energy return on push-off. The nylon stabiliser sheet prevents excessive inward rolling during lunges. The U-Shape 3.0 last accommodates the wider forefoot profile common among Indian players without compressing the toes.
Technology Breakdown for Victor A301 IN Badminton Shoes:

Victor's proprietary shock-absorbing midsole material. ENERGYMAX compresses under impact — jump landings, hard direction changes — absorbing the force before it reaches the ankle and knee joints. It then rebounds quickly, returning energy to the foot's push-off into the next movement. Present in Victor's mid-range and upper-range shoes at higher concentrations; its presence in Victor A301 IN Badminton Shoes means the foundational cushioning technology is consistent across the All-Around lineup.

The U-Shape designation reflects a toe box that widens toward the front rather than tapering — matching the natural rounded profile of many Indian players' feet. Version 3.0 (the current iteration) refines this with a reduced instep height and narrower ankle area compared to earlier versions, providing modern low-profile fit without the "bulky" feeling of older wide-fit lasts. Accommodates wider, rounder forefoot profiles comfortably without pressure points at the sides of the toes, while maintaining a snug heel fit that prevents sliding during lateral movements.

A structural component positioned in the midsole under the arch, between the EVA layer and the outsole. Its function is torsional stabilisation — resisting the midsole's tendency to twist under lateral loading forces. During a wide lunge, significant inward rolling force acts on the arch and heel. Without a stabiliser, this rolling transmits through the pliable EVA, contributing to arch fatigue. The nylon sheet's rigidity provides a structural floor limiting this excessive rolling, keeping the foot in a more neutral position through lateral movements.

A dedicated breathing mesh layer in the upper promotes airflow through the shoe during play, facilitating heat dissipation from the foot. During extended badminton sessions — particularly in India's warm climate — foot temperature management is a comfort and fatigue factor. The mesh panels in combination with PU Leather structure allow air circulation while maintaining the upper's structural integrity for support and durability through regular use.
Shoe Finder — Is Victor A301 IN Badminton Shoes Right for You?

You currently play in running shoes or general sports shoes and want to make your first proper badminton shoe purchase. You play 1–2 times per week and are still developing basic technique and footwork. A301 IN is ideal for you as it provides every court-specific feature that separates a proper badminton shoe from running shoes — at Victor's most accessible India price. The improvement in lateral stability and grip will be immediately noticeable. No need to spend more until you're playing at least 3 times per week consistently.

You play consistently at recreational to intermediate club level. You want a reliable training shoe that handles regular sessions without rapid wear and doesn't require you to think about your footwear during play. A301 IN works well for you. ENERGYMAX retains its cushioning over time, the rubber outsole is durable under regular use, and the PU Leather + Mesh upper holds its structure through hundreds of sessions. A practical, honest training shoe at this frequency. Consider stepping up only when competitive performance becomes a regular priority.

You are buying a badminton shoe for a young player who is still growing and will likely need a replacement shoe within 12–18 months as their foot develops. Victor A301 IN Badminton Shoes is the right developmental shoe. The India-specific IN pricing makes it the most economically sensible choice for a shoe that will be outgrown. It provides all court-specific protection — non-marking outsole, proper midsole cushioning, arch support — without overinvesting in a premium shoe that won't be worn for long.
Foot Health & Shoe Selection Guide for Victor A301 IN Badminton Shoes:

One of the most common questions God of Sports receives is about foot conditions — flat feet, heel pain, arch issues — and whether Victor A301 IN Badminton Shoes or a different type of shoe is appropriate. This guide covers the five most common conditions. For each, we explain what it is, what to look for in a badminton shoe, and how the A301 IN measures up.

The arch is low or absent, causing the inner edge of the foot to roll inward excessively during movement — a pattern called overpronation. During badminton's lateral lunges this inward rolling strains the ankle, knee, and lower leg, and can cause arch and heel pain over time.

Wet your foot and step on paper. A full flat footprint with no visible arch curve suggests flat feet. If the inner sole of your current shoes is significantly more worn than the outer side, you are likely overpronating.

Arch support to limit inward rolling · Firm midsole (soft plush cushioning can worsen overpronation) · Wide stable base · Torsion stabiliser in the midsole · Removable insole slot for custom orthotics · Firm heel counter.

Victor A301 IN Badminton Shoes verdict: Moderate match. The nylon stabiliser sheet and wide U-Shape 3.0 base provide useful moderate stability for mild-to-moderate overpronation. For moderate-to-severe flat feet, pair the A301 IN with an aftermarket arch support insole — available at most pharmacies. For severe flat feet with ankle or knee pain history, consult a podiatrist who can prescribe custom orthotics that fit inside the A301 IN's removable insole slot.

A very pronounced, rigid arch causes the foot to roll outward (supinate) rather than absorb shock through the arch. High-arched feet tend to place excessive pressure on the heel and ball of the foot, and are more prone to ankle sprains during lateral movement.
Wet your foot and step on paper. If only the heel and ball are visible with almost no midfoot contact, you likely have a high arch.

High cushioning to compensate for poor natural shock absorption · Neutral or curved last (not a stability/motion-control shoe, which worsens the condition) · Flexible midsole for natural foot motion · Cushioned insole · Softer heel counter.

Victor A301 IN Badminton Shoes verdict: Moderate match. The ENERGYMAX + EVA midsole provides decent cushioning. However, the nylon stabiliser sheet adds rigidity that high-arched, already rigid feet may not need. Players with high arches may find the A301 IN firmer than ideal. A cushioned aftermarket insole helps significantly. For significant high arch with a history of ankle sprains, consult a podiatrist before selecting any footwear.

Inflammation of the plantar fascia — the thick band of tissue running along the bottom of the foot from heel to toes. Causes sharp, stabbing heel pain especially with the first steps in the morning. Common in players who suddenly increase playing frequency, play long sessions in poor footwear, or have flat feet that overload the fascia.

Firm arch support to distribute load away from the fascia · Heel cushioning to absorb impact · Firm heel counter to stabilise rear-foot position · Slight heel-to-toe drop (gentle heel elevation reduces fascia tension) · Avoid flat or zero-drop shoes · Removable insole for orthotics.

Victor A301 IN Badminton Shoes verdict: Moderate match. The ENERGYMAX heel cushioning and nylon arch stabiliser address key plantar fasciitis risk factors. However, for players actively experiencing PF pain, the shoe alone is unlikely to be sufficient — pair with a heel cushion insert or plantar fasciitis insole. Active plantar fasciitis requires physiotherapy, rest, and stretching (calf and plantar fascia stretches) alongside proper footwear. Do not attempt to play through acute PF pain without professional guidance.

Heel pain can stem from plantar fasciitis, heel spurs, or Achilles tendinopathy — inflammation at the back of the heel where the Achilles tendon inserts. Common in players who increase session frequency suddenly, play in flat shoes that overstretch the tendon, or have tight calf muscles. Presents as pain at the back or underside of the heel.

Padded heel cup for impact absorption · Slight heel-to-toe drop reducing Achilles tension · Firm heel counter preventing heel shift inside the shoe · Padded heel collar to avoid rubbing at the Achilles insertion · Avoid very flexible or flat heel areas.

Victor A301 IN Badminton Shoes verdict: Moderate match. The ENERGYMAX heel cushioning and padded heel collar address heel comfort, and the EVA midsole's slight heel elevation reduces Achilles strain compared to flat shoes. For mild heel discomfort from transitioning to more play, the A301 IN is likely adequate combined with calf stretching and gradual load increase. For established Achilles tendinopathy or a confirmed heel spur, see a physiotherapist — footwear alone will not resolve these conditions.

Many Indian players have wider feet than the standard D or 2E width assumed by most entry badminton shoes. A standard-width shoe creates pressure on the sides of the toes and forefoot — causing discomfort, blisters, and black toenails from repeated compression. It also reduces balance quality as the toes cannot spread naturally during push-off.
Wide-fit last (U-Shape) · Rounded toe box that does not taper · Sufficient forefoot volume · Adequate length so toes are not pushed against the front during lunges.

Victor A301 IN Badminton Shoes verdict: Excellent match — this is the A301 IN's strongest point. The U-Shape 3.0 last accommodates wider, rounder forefoot profiles at true size — no need to size up for width. lines: God of Sports Expert Verdict on Victor A301 IN Badminton Shoes:

Most Indian players begin their badminton journey in running shoes. This is understandable — running shoes are what most people already own — but it is a genuine performance and safety handicap. Running shoes are engineered for forward linear movement, with cushioning profiles that push energy back in a forward direction and soles that grip in a straight line. Badminton requires constant lateral movement, sudden direction changes, and repeated vertical jumping and landing. Running shoes actively work against these movement patterns, providing poor lateral stability, inadequate multi-directional grip, and cushioning that fatigues the foot during extended court sessions.

Victor A301 IN Badminton Shoes addresses every one of these limitations. The non-marking rubber outsole grips for lateral slides and direction changes. The ENERGYMAX + EVA midsole cushions vertical impact on landings and provides energy return on push-off. The nylon stabiliser sheet prevents excessive inward rolling during lunges. The U-Shape 3.0 last accommodates the wider forefoot profile common among Indian players without compressing the toes.
Technology Breakdown for Victor A301 IN Badminton Shoes:

Victor's proprietary shock-absorbing midsole material. ENERGYMAX compresses under impact — jump landings, hard direction changes — absorbing the force before it reaches the ankle and knee joints. It then rebounds quickly, returning energy to the foot's push-off into the next movement. Present in Victor's mid-range and upper-range shoes at higher concentrations; its presence in Victor A301 IN Badminton Shoes means the foundational cushioning technology is consistent across the All-Around lineup.

The U-Shape designation reflects a toe box that widens toward the front rather than tapering — matching the natural rounded profile of many Indian players' feet. Version 3.0 (the current iteration) refines this with a reduced instep height and narrower ankle area compared to earlier versions, providing modern low-profile fit without the "bulky" feeling of older wide-fit lasts. Accommodates wider, rounder forefoot profiles comfortably without pressure points at the sides of the toes, while maintaining a snug heel fit that prevents sliding during lateral movements.

A structural component positioned in the midsole under the arch, between the EVA layer and the outsole. Its function is torsional stabilisation — resisting the midsole's tendency to twist under lateral loading forces. During a wide lunge, significant inward rolling force acts on the arch and heel. Without a stabiliser, this rolling transmits through the pliable EVA, contributing to arch fatigue. The nylon sheet's rigidity provides a structural floor limiting this excessive rolling, keeping the foot in a more neutral position through lateral movements.

A dedicated breathing mesh layer in the upper promotes airflow through the shoe during play, facilitating heat dissipation from the foot. During extended badminton sessions — particularly in India's warm climate — foot temperature management is a comfort and fatigue factor. The mesh panels in combination with PU Leather structure allow air circulation while maintaining the upper's structural integrity for support and durability through regular use.
Shoe Finder — Is Victor A301 IN Badminton Shoes Right for You?

You currently play in running shoes or general sports shoes and want to make your first proper badminton shoe purchase. You play 1–2 times per week and are still developing basic technique and footwork. A301 IN is ideal for you as it provides every court-specific feature that separates a proper badminton shoe from running shoes — at Victor's most accessible India price. The improvement in lateral stability and grip will be immediately noticeable. No need to spend more until you're playing at least 3 times per week consistently.

You play consistently at recreational to intermediate club level. You want a reliable training shoe that handles regular sessions without rapid wear and doesn't require you to think about your footwear during play. A301 IN works well for you. ENERGYMAX retains its cushioning over time, the rubber outsole is durable under regular use, and the PU Leather + Mesh upper holds its structure through hundreds of sessions. A practical, honest training shoe at this frequency. Consider stepping up only when competitive performance becomes a regular priority.

You are buying a badminton shoe for a young player who is still growing and will likely need a replacement shoe within 12–18 months as their foot develops. Victor A301 IN Badminton Shoes is the right developmental shoe. The India-specific IN pricing makes it the most economically sensible choice for a shoe that will be outgrown. It provides all court-specific protection — non-marking outsole, proper midsole cushioning, arch support — without overinvesting in a premium shoe that won't be worn for long.
Foot Health & Shoe Selection Guide for Victor A301 IN Badminton Shoes:

One of the most common questions God of Sports receives is about foot conditions — flat feet, heel pain, arch issues — and whether Victor A301 IN Badminton Shoes or a different type of shoe is appropriate. This guide covers the five most common conditions. For each, we explain what it is, what to look for in a badminton shoe, and how the A301 IN measures up.

The arch is low or absent, causing the inner edge of the foot to roll inward excessively during movement — a pattern called overpronation. During badminton's lateral lunges this inward rolling strains the ankle, knee, and lower leg, and can cause arch and heel pain over time.

Wet your foot and step on paper. A full flat footprint with no visible arch curve suggests flat feet. If the inner sole of your current shoes is significantly more worn than the outer side, you are likely overpronating.

Arch support to limit inward rolling · Firm midsole (soft plush cushioning can worsen overpronation) · Wide stable base · Torsion stabiliser in the midsole · Removable insole slot for custom orthotics · Firm heel counter.

Victor A301 IN Badminton Shoes verdict: Moderate match. The nylon stabiliser sheet and wide U-Shape 3.0 base provide useful moderate stability for mild-to-moderate overpronation. For moderate-to-severe flat feet, pair the A301 IN with an aftermarket arch support insole — available at most pharmacies. For severe flat feet with ankle or knee pain history, consult a podiatrist who can prescribe custom orthotics that fit inside the A301 IN's removable insole slot.

A very pronounced, rigid arch causes the foot to roll outward (supinate) rather than absorb shock through the arch. High-arched feet tend to place excessive pressure on the heel and ball of the foot, and are more prone to ankle sprains during lateral movement.
Wet your foot and step on paper. If only the heel and ball are visible with almost no midfoot contact, you likely have a high arch.

High cushioning to compensate for poor natural shock absorption · Neutral or curved last (not a stability/motion-control shoe, which worsens the condition) · Flexible midsole for natural foot motion · Cushioned insole · Softer heel counter.

A cushioned aftermarket insole helps significantly. For significant high arch with a history of ankle sprains, consult a podiatrist before selecting any footwear.

Inflammation of the plantar fascia — the thick band of tissue running along the bottom of the foot from heel to toes. Causes sharp, stabbing heel pain especially with the first steps in the morning. Common in players who suddenly increase playing frequency, play long sessions in poor footwear, or have flat feet that overload the fascia.

Firm arch support to distribute load away from the fascia · Heel cushioning to absorb impact · Firm heel counter to stabilise rear-foot position · Slight heel-to-toe drop (gentle heel elevation reduces fascia tension) · Avoid flat or zero-drop shoes · Removable insole for orthotics.

Victor A301 IN Badminton Shoes verdict: Moderate match. The ENERGYMAX heel cushioning and nylon arch stabiliser address key plantar fasciitis risk factors. However, for players actively experiencing PF pain, the shoe alone is unlikely to be sufficient — pair with a heel cushion insert or plantar fasciitis insole. Active plantar fasciitis requires physiotherapy, rest, and stretching (calf and plantar fascia stretches) alongside proper footwear. Do not attempt to play through acute PF pain without professional guidance.

Heel pain can stem from plantar fasciitis, heel spurs, or Achilles tendinopathy — inflammation at the back of the heel where the Achilles tendon inserts. Common in players who increase session frequency suddenly, play in flat shoes that overstretch the tendon, or have tight calf muscles. Presents as pain at the back or underside of the heel.

Padded heel cup for impact absorption · Slight heel-to-toe drop reducing Achilles tension · Firm heel counter preventing heel shift inside the shoe · Padded heel collar to avoid rubbing at the Achilles insertion · Avoid very flexible or flat heel areas.

Victor A301 IN Badminton Shoes verdict: Moderate match. The ENERGYMAX heel cushioning and padded heel collar address heel comfort, and the EVA midsole's slight heel elevation reduces Achilles strain compared to flat shoes. For mild heel discomfort from transitioning to more play, the A301 IN is likely adequate combined with calf stretching and gradual load increase. For established Achilles tendinopathy or a confirmed heel spur, see a physiotherapist — footwear alone will not resolve these conditions.

A standard-width shoe creates pressure on the sides of the toes and forefoot — causing discomfort, blisters, and black toenails from repeated compression. It also reduces balance quality as the toes cannot spread naturally during push-off.

Victor P8500 TD IN Badminton Shoes is built around one central idea: protecting the player during aggressive lateral movement. The 3D Tri-Claw design — the iconic lateral support structure that defines the P8500 line — is a three-dimensional reinforcement on the outside of the shoe that physically braces the foot against the inward rolling forces that occur during sudden direction changes. The gold-lacquered finish on the Black/Gold colourway makes this structural element visually prominent, but its purpose is entirely functional.

The five-layer midsole stack (HYPEREVA + ENERGYMAX3.0 + TPU ASYS + Carbon Power + Solid EVA) is the most technically sophisticated midsole in the Victor India range available at God of Sports. Each layer has a specific function: HYPEREVA handles primary cushioning and energy return; ENERGYMAX3.0 adds rebound responsiveness; the TPU ASYS element prevents arch pronation; Carbon Power provides torsional rigidity; and the Solid EVA base provides durable structural foundation. Together they produce a midsole that manages the complex multi-directional forces of competitive badminton more precisely than simpler stack constructions.
The U-Shape 3.0 wide-fit last means this performance is accessible to wider-footed players — an important feature at this price tier where many competing performance shoes use narrow standard lasts.

During a wide lunge or sudden stop-and-change, the Tri-Claw limits the degree to which the foot rolls inward, reducing ankle roll risk and transmitting force more efficiently through the midsole stack.

HYPEREVA is Victor's most advanced midsole compound: 22% more rebound than standard EVA, 19% weight reduction, 5% more flexibility, 16% better durability. Carbon Power is a three-dimensional carbon fibre sheet positioned in the midsole providing torsional rigidity — it resists the twisting forces that occur across the arch during lateral movement, preventing midsole deformation under load. The TPU ASYS (Arch Stability System) is a high-strength thermoplastic element positioned at the arch that prevents pronation and torsional strain, keeping the foot in a neutral, supported position through intensive footwork.

VSR (Victor Slip-Resistant) Rubber delivers 21% better grip on dry PU courts vs standard rubber — the primary indoor surface in India. V-Tough at the inner toe provides 16x more wear resistance than average PU leather, significantly extending the shoe's life in the highest-wear zone. LS-S (Lateral Stability System) applies high-strength TPU to the outer forefoot, reinforcing the area that experiences the most lateral stress during direction changes.

name: Li-Ning Halberd Strike Badminton Shoes (Blue Jade/Floating Green)
lines: God of Sports Expert Verdict on Li-Ning Halberd Strike Badminton Shoes:

The Halberd Strike is Li-Ning's step up from an entry-level court shoe like the All Round, built around LN Cloud cushioning and a ProbarLoc stability plate for players who move fast and change direction hard.
Its midfoot stability is near the top of its class, which shows up on court as confident, controlled lunges rather than the foot rolling under a sharp direction change.
It trades some of the All Round's forgiving width for a snugger, more locked-in fit - a deliberate choice for a shoe built around explosive movement rather than all-day comfort.

This is the shoe for an intermediate-to-advanced player who trains and plays regularly enough to want dedicated cushioning and stability, rather than a once-a-week club player who'd be better served by a lighter, more accessible shoe.
LN Cloud Midsole — shock absorption with a responsive feel:
Li-Ning's cushioning foam compresses on landing and snaps back on push-off, softening the repeated jumps and lunges of a full session while still feeling responsive rather than soft and dead.
ProbarLoc Stability Plate — a locked-in midfoot on hard direction changes:
A reinforced plate under the arch resists twisting when you plant hard and change direction, which is what reviewers are rating highly when they praise the shoe's stability under explosive movement.
Non-Marking Rubber Outsole — grip that doesn't scuff the court:
A grippy tread holds on wooden and synthetic indoor courts through sudden stops and changes of direction, while the non-marking compound keeps shared court surfaces clean.
Breathable Mesh Upper with Grid Ventilation — cooler through a long session:
Ventilation channels in the mesh let heat and moisture escape during extended rallies, which matters more than it sounds once a session runs past the first game.
Shoe Finder — Is This Right for You?
if you're on court often enough to feel the difference between a basic midsole and a cushioned, stable one, the LN Cloud and ProbarLoc combination is built exactly for that.
Players who plant hard and change direction aggressively:
the stability plate is most valuable to a player whose game involves sharp lunges and quick recovery steps, not gentle, measured footwork.

this is not officially a wide-fit shoe - it runs snug and a little narrow through the midfoot, and reviewers consistently flag it as tighter than average. Wide-footed players are likely to find the All Round's roomier build more comfortable.
Not for occasional club players on a budget:
if you play once or twice a week and don't yet need dedicated cushioning and stability tech, Li-Ning's lighter, more accessible All Round covers the same all-court ground for less.
Feet with a low or collapsed arch that can roll inward (overpronate) under load, which shows up most during lunges and sharp direction changes.
A firm medial midsole or dedicated arch support that resists inward roll, plus a stable heel counter.
Halberd Strike for Flat Feet: Moderate match.

The ProbarLoc plate gives only moderate support for flat-footed players compared with neutral or high-arch feet, so a flat-footed player who overpronates noticeably may still want an aftermarket insole.
A high arch reduces the foot's natural shock absorption, transferring more impact up through the foot and ankle on hard landings.
Extra midsole cushioning and a flexible forefoot that lets the foot splay naturally on landing.
Halberd Strike for High Arch: Good match.
This is where the shoe is reported to perform best - the LN Cloud midsole's cushioning and the plate's support suit a high-arched foot particularly well.
Inflammation of the band of tissue along the sole of the foot, causing heel pain often worst with the first steps of the day or after a long session.
Strong heel cushioning, a supportive footbed, and a shoe that doesn't flex too freely under the arch.
Halberd Strike for Plantar Fasciitis: Moderate match.

The ProbarLoc plate adds helpful arch-area support, but the snug fit can press on a sensitive foot, so anyone managing active plantar fasciitis should consult a podiatrist or physiotherapist before committing to long sessions in this shoe.
Sensitivity or past injury around the heel and Achilles tendon, aggravated by shoes with a stiff or poorly padded heel counter during sudden stops and lunges.
A padded, well-shaped heel collar and a slightly raised, cushioned heel to reduce Achilles strain.
Halberd Strike for Heel & Achilles: Good match.

The LN Cloud midsole's landing cushioning helps reduce the jarring that aggravates Achilles sensitivity, though anyone recovering from a recent injury should consult a physiotherapist before returning to full-intensity movement in any shoe.
A foot with a wider forefoot or midfoot that feels pinched in a standard last, often showing up as discomfort along the outside edge during lateral lunges.
A roomier toe box and a mesh or softer upper that gives slightly rather than a rigid, snug-fitting shell.
Halberd Strike for Wide Feet: Poor match.

This is explicitly not marketed as a wide-fit shoe, and reviewers consistently describe the fit as snug to narrow. Wide-footed players are likely to be more comfortable in Li-Ning's All Round, which runs roomier.
